captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Their jonin instructor, Kakashi Hatake, orders them to the training ground at dawn for a survival test. No breakfast.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi Hatake will not be there at dawn. He is late to everything.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto knows. It's in eleven reports.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Which gives him the training ground, three hours, and two hundred clones.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By the time the others arrive there are fourteen wires,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: six trenches, and one very confused squirrel.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, the squirrel is still in the net.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Leave him. He's a witness.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Why are you standing in a ditch?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Listen, both of you. It's a teamwork test.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He's failed every team before us. I know 'cause I filed the paperwork.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You're dead last. Why would I believe you?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Nobody knows what the test is, Naruto.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: And honestly? You're annoying. Why would I trust you?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Because I've never lied to you. Okay, three times. This isn't one of them.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: If this goes wrong, I'm blaming you.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Fair. Blame me. I'll be right next to you.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I don't need a team.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Good. Me neither. I just need you to listen.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Knowing the answer is useless if nobody will listen.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The obstacle was never power. It is trust.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Fine. Here's the deal. Whatever bells we get, you two take them.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I'll be the one who goes back to the Academy.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I just need two of us to pass.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Naruto. You would really do that?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Hm. Fine. Stop talking and show me the plan.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Kakashi strolls in, book open, and finds three genin waiting in a perfect triangle.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He turns a page.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sorry I'm late. I got lost on the road of life.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Two bells. Three of you. Whoever has none goes back to the Academy. Begin.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Come at me with the intent to kill. It's the only way you'll ever touch me.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Is he serious? He can't be serious.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: He's serious. Get ready.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Nobody moves.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then Sasuke opens with a fireball, and Kakashi, for the first time today, has to move.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He lands on a wire Naruto strung at dawn.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sakura's kunai cuts it, and a log swings in.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi dodges the log, then the kunai, then the second log nobody told him about.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's still holding the book. He's no longer reading it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Not bad. Whoever planned that.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Then Sasuke throws a windmill shuriken.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi sidesteps it, bored. And the shuriken is Naruto.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, Naruto pulls this exact trick on Zabuza, months from now. He's just early.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A hand closes around a bell. Kakashi's one visible eye goes wide.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Wait. Who taught you that?
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: A lot of me.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Sasuke. Catch.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You're giving it to me?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: I said I would. Two of us have to pass.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You'd hand over your own bell? Then all three of you pass.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Already?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: It's the first time I've said that. Do not ruin it.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: It's the first team Kakashi Hatake has ever passed. He does it in ten minutes.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That was actually kind of smart, Naruto.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: I know. I read it somewhere.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Same time tomorrow. Do not be late.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: You're the one who's always late.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Right. Fair point.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Every team before them failed. This one passed because one boy had read the file.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That night, Kakashi stands in the Hokage's office,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: and for once he doesn't open with a joke.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They passed. First try. Ten minutes.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Congratulations, Kakashi. You're finally a teacher.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: That wasn't a compliment, was it?
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Not entirely.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Tell me. How did Sasuke take it?
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: He called him a loser. Then he said thank you. Quietly, so nobody would notice.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Progress.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Lord Third. What exactly have you let him read?
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Only what any clerk reads. Forms. Receipts. Reports. He asked politely.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: A beat passes. Then another.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Third Hokage studies his pipe as if it has just told a clever joke.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Two in the morning.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The archive is empty, except for one filing box that isn't a filing box.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It's a clone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto left him behind, transformed, to finish the shelf marked off limits.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Do not breathe loudly. Do not breathe at all. You're a box.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Rule one, touch nothing. Rule two, touch everything. Rule three, don't get caught.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The off-limits shelf. Twelve years of dust. And one box where a clerk in a hurry filed the wrong sheet.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A hospital roster. Medical leave, October, twelve years ago.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It's alphabetical. One line's inked out. Above it, Uzuki. Below it, Yakushi.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Somebody blacked out the name. Nobody thought to re-alphabetize the page.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: I've filed the whole clan registry. Exactly one name fits between Uzuki and Yakushi.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He has written that name on every form he has ever signed in his life.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The leave ends October tenth. That's my birthday.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Authorized by the Fourth Hokage.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The clone pops.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Across the village, Naruto sits bolt upright in bed, holding a memory he never lived.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Breathe. It's only a clone's memory. It's just a clone's memory.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Uzumaki. There was another one.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Deep under the seal, in the dark behind the bars, one enormous red eye opens.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A thousand of you, brat. And every one carries a piece of me.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: Did you think I wasn't reading too?
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: Her name was Kushina. I should know. I lived in her before I lived in you.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: Before Naruto, the Nine-Tails was sealed inside a woman named Kushina Uzumaki.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That part is not a what-if.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In Part Two, a twelve year old asks the Third Hokage one question,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: and the old man has to decide whether to lie to a thousand witnesses.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Old man. Who was Kushina Uzumaki?
captions.speaker: NARUTO
